restore.text: The account can sign in again, with all its notes.

role.title: Change the role of {{name}}?
role.toMember: The account becomes a member and runs nothing from now on.
role.toOperator: The account becomes an operator and runs the server and the accounts from now on, without seeing anybody else's notes.

signOut.text: Every session of this account ends. It can sign in again afterwards.

recording.hint: Tap a word to jump to that point of the recording.
recording.transcriptMissing: The text is not there yet.
recording.cannotPlay: Your browser cannot play this format.

ocr.title: Recognized text
ocr.pending: Text is still being recognized. Search finds it as soon as it is done.
ocr.pendingPages_one: Page {{pages}}: text is still being recognized. Search finds it as soon as it is done.
ocr.pendingPages_other: Pages {{pages}}: text is still being recognized. Search finds it as soon as it is done.
ocr.unavailable: Text recognition is not set up on this server.
ocr.locked: The note is locked. Its text is not recognized.

dialog.title: Share “{{title}}”
dialog.onlyYouNote: Only you decide who sees the note. Others cannot share it further.
dialog.onlyYouFolder: Only you decide who sees the folder. Others cannot share it further.
dialog.nobody: Nobody on this server goes by that. You can only share with accounts here.

link.title: Link to read, no account needed
link.hidden: The link is active. nexnotes shows its address only when it is created.
link.renew: Create a new link (the old one stops working)

links.title: Read links
links.text: Links that let somebody without an account read one of your notes.

shares.ended: “{{title}}” is not here any more: {{name}} stopped sharing it.
shares.ownerGone: “{{title}}” is not here any more: the account of {{name}} was deleted.
shares.nowRead: {{name}} changed your right: you can only read this note now.

page.title: Shared with me
page.text: Notes and folders others shared with you. They stay theirs.
page.empty: Nobody has shared anything with you yet.

move.title: No longer shared?
move.one: “{{title}}” is in a shared folder. Anywhere else it is no longer shared with: {{people}}.
move.many_one: {{count}} note is in a shared folder. Anywhere else it is no longer shared with: {{people}}.
move.many_other: {{count}} notes are in a shared folder. Anywhere else they are no longer shared with: {{people}}.

vault.differs: The two passwords are not the same.
vault.titleHint: The title stays readable so that you can find the note. Keep secrets out of the title.

setup.title: Set up the vault
setup.text: Locked notes are encrypted on your device. The server and its operator see nothing but encrypted data. One password covers all your locked notes.
setup.warning: A forgotten password means the content is gone. Nobody can bring it back, not even the operator.
setup.understood: I understand that a forgotten password cannot be reset.

lock.title: Lock note
lock.text: Enter your vault password. The note is encrypted here before it goes to the server.

unlock.title: This note is locked
unlock.text: It is decrypted here in the browser. When you close the tab, it is locked again.
unlock.wrong_one: Wrong. One more try, then you will have to wait.
unlock.wrong_other: Wrong. After three wrong tries: wait 30 seconds.
unlock.tooMany: Too many wrong tries. Wait until the time is up.

remove.title: Remove lock
remove.text: Enter your vault password. The note then is a normal note again: the server can read it, the search finds its text.

change.title: Change password
change.text: All locked notes then open with the new password, on every device. Where one is open right now, it locks.
change.done: The new vault password counts from now on.

forgot.title: Start a new vault
forgot.warning_one: Without the old password only a new vault is possible. Your {{count}} locked note is lost then, for the operator too.
forgot.warning_other: Without the old password only a new vault is possible. All {{count}} locked notes are lost then, for the operator too.
forgot.done_one: The new vault is ready. {{count}} locked note was deleted.
forgot.done_other: The new vault is ready. {{count}} locked notes were deleted.
forgot.provider: For this you sign in at your provider once more; the sign-in may be {{minutes}} minutes old at most.

section.title: Vault
section.text: One password for all locked notes. It never leaves your device.
section.none: No vault yet. It comes with the first note you lock.

notify.folderBelow: Applies to every note and subfolder in it.
notify.bundled: Bundled: a notification comes once nobody has written for two minutes. Your own changes are not reported.
notify.deniedHelp: Your browser blocks notifications from nexnotes. Allow them in the site settings (usually through the icon left of the address, under “Notifications”), then choose “Allow” here.
notify.unsupportedHelp: This browser cannot show notifications from websites. On an iPhone they work in the iOS app or with nexnotes added to the Home Screen as a web app.
notify.notSharedNote: Notifications are for shared notes: they tell you when others change something.
notify.notSharedFolder: Notifications are for shared folders: share the folder first, then they tell you when others change something in it.

dialog.readHint: Search, read, list folders and tags.
dialog.writeHint: Also make notes, add to them, tick items off, move them, make folders and put notes into the trash.

consent.title: Connect “{{name}}”?
consent.text: The program then works with your notes as you: never more than you may. Afterwards you go back to {{host}}.
consent.broken: This connection request is incomplete. Start connecting in the program again.
consent.later: You find the program under Settings, Connections, and revoke it there.

smart.heading: Smart
smart.deleteSays: Only the smart folder goes, without the trash. The notes in it stay where they are.
smart.name: Name
smart.matchAllSays: Fits when all conditions are met:
smart.matchAnySays: Fits when at least one condition is met:
smart.previewHint: Choose a condition to see here which notes fit.
smart.missingTitle: This smart folder does not exist
smart.missingText: It was deleted, perhaps on another device.

broken.folder: The folder “{{name}}” of a condition was deleted. This condition fits no note.
broken.tag: The tag {{tag}} of a condition is in no note any more.

smart.keys: Alt with arrow up or down moves a smart folder, Shift+F10 or the menu key opens its menu.

pwa.update: A new version of nexnotes is here.

offline.title: No connection
offline.text: nexnotes in the browser needs the server. As soon as the network is back, it goes on.
offline.hint: Writing without network works in the iPhone and iPad app.

share.title: Save to nexnotes
share.offline: No connection. What was shared stays here until the network is back; then tap “Save” again.
share.tooLarge: “{{name}}” is larger than allowed ({{max_mb}} MB) and is not saved.
share.lost: What was shared is not here (any more): saved, cancelled or too long ago. Please share it again.

section.title: nextasks
section.text: Lines and checklist items can be sent to your nextasks as tasks.
section.how: To connect: create an API key that reads and writes in nextasks under My account, Connections, and enter the address of nextasks and the key here.
section.localOff: If your nextasks runs in the local network, the operator has to allow that first under Settings, Server.
section.disconnectText: The tasks stay in nextasks, and so do the marks beside the lines. New lines can be sent after connecting again.

send.title: Send to nextasks
send.nothing: Put the cursor in a line or select lines with text.
send.hint: The line stays here and gets a link to the task.

gone.title: Task no longer there
gone.text: This task is no longer in nextasks. The line stays as it is.

section.title: API tokens
section.text: An API token lets a program read your notes and, if you want, write them: n8n, Home Assistant, a script or the nexdeck card. It never may more than your account. It never sees locked notes.
section.off: The operator switched the API off. Existing tokens work again once it is switched on.
section.once: Copy the token now. It is shown only this once.
section.header: Programs send the token as “Authorization: Bearer …”, AI tools to …/api/mcp.
section.revokeText: The program is shut out at once. What it wrote stays.

dialog.title: New API token
dialog.name: Name
dialog.readHint: Read notes, folders, tags, search, attachments and the trash.
dialog.writeHint: Also tick checklists and, once that comes, make and change notes.
dialog.mcpHint: The token then also works at …/api/mcp.
dialog.mcpOff: The operator has switched MCP off.

connectors.title: Connected AI tools
connectors.text: Programs that connected themselves with your consent. They work as you, never with more.

admin.title: API tokens of all accounts
admin.text: Per token the account, name, right, access, run-out and last use. Never the token, never titles or contents.
admin.none: No account has an API token yet.
admin.blockText: The token stops working at once. The account sees it as “Blocked by the operator”.
